messages.author: 20758fda448fdbda
messages.subject: Focus on N_eff after R_hat  ~ 1?
parts: This may be obvious, but if after n simulations all the parameters have their Gelman-Rubin statistics very close to 1, is any further precision gained by running more simulations to increase N_eff?

messages.author: cab04b8f0759c712
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Focus on N_eff after R_hat ~ 1?
parts: Yes, there is further precision to be gained. Just like standard error for a population mean is inversely proportional to sqrt(N), that is se = sd / sqrt(N), Monte Carlo standard error (mcse) is inversely proportional to sqrt(N_eff).
